puntos.texto: Rockström et al. propose nine boundaries

turnos.t: The planetary boundaries model describes nine Earth-system processes that have regulated the stability of the Earth system during the Holocene, and sets a safe operating space for humanity for each one.

Always quote the year. Richardson and colleagues, 2023: six of nine transgressed. Climate change, biosphere integrity, land-system change, freshwater change, biogeochemical flows and novel entities. The 2025 Planetary Health Check added ocean acidification: seven of nine. Ozone and aerosols are still within the safe space.
